summary: Biodexa Pharmaceuticals Plc filed a Form 6-K on May 14, 2026, distributing its annual report and notice of Annual General Meeting scheduled for June 17, 2026. The filing includes a letter to shareholders explaining proposals to reorganize the company's share capital—consolidating an exceptionally large number of ordinary shares—without affecting shareholder rights or the number of ADSs outstanding. There are no acquisition, divestiture, or special-situation terms disclosed. The filing is a routine AGM notice and capital reorganization proposal, not a special situation triggering an event-driven category. No price, premium, or deal mechanics are stated.
